title: The model-name check reads a spawn's agent-file default and matches each round to its own spawn
why: Three lanes (builder-report-in-head, verdict-format-line, notes-fix-delete-leftovers) hit the model-name false alarm on Nov 8: a spawn with no model field read as sonnet, and a Done item's reviewer model matched only the latest spawn.
note: Done check: red cases built from the three lanes' refusal texts, then green; review rounds 1-3. Also covers model-guard-next-only and step report-guard-all-spawns. Overlap settled (coordinator, 07:57 CST Nov 8): built on top of #1919 and #1946 with no second copy; it fixes only what still fails on that base. Doing in lane model-guard-reads-next (coordinator, 07:51 CST Nov 8).
